theory.intro: When adding or subtracting numbers with different numbers of digits, line them up by place value so each column holds ones, tens, hundreds and so on.
facts: **Align the place values** (ones under ones, tens under tens) — line up the right-hand ends for whole numbers.
Add a column at a time, **carrying** into the next column when it reaches $10$ or more.
When adding three or more numbers, a column total can be larger than $19$ — carry the full tens part.
steps: Write the numbers in a column, aligned by place value.
Add (or subtract) the ones, then tens, then hundreds, carrying or borrowing as needed.

foundation.question_text: Calculate $42000+5123+246$ by grouping digits with the same place value.
Calculate $735+64+8$ by aligning the place values.
Calculate $3806+475+29$ by grouping digits with the same place value.
Calculate $8200+906+75+4$ by aligning the place values.

development.question_text: Calculate $5687+2498+936+79$. Take care when a column total is greater than $19$.
A student rewrites $42000+5123+246$ as $42000+51230+24600$. Explain the place-value error and calculate the original sum.
development.solution_text:
The student shifted the shorter numbers left instead of aligning their ones digits.
$42000+5123+246$
$=47369$

development.question_text: Three numbers have a total of $25000$. Two of the numbers are $18450$ and $675$. Find the third number.

mastery.question_text: Calculate $6875+5489+3968$. Show how you handle a column total greater than $19$.
mastery.solution_text:
In the ones column, $5+9+8=22$, so write $2$ ones and carry $2$ tens.
$6875+5489+3968$
$=12364+3968$
$=16332$

mastery.question_text: Niko places $58$ in the hundreds and tens columns when adding $7240+583+58$, so it acts as $580$. Explain the error and find the correct total.
mastery.solution_text:
$58$ has $5$ tens and $8$ ones, so its ones digit must align with the other ones digits.
$7240+583+58$
$=7823+58$
$=7881$
